statement: The proportion of mothers reporting previous medical complications differs between SUID cases recorded in NCFRP_v51 and live births reported through PRAMS_P7_ARF.
rationale: This design compares how maternal physical health conditions are measured differently between SUID cases (NCFRP_v51) and live births (PRAMS_P7_ARF).
prior_art: None in the inputs. The manuscript claims do not address differences in maternal physical health condition reporting between SUID cases and live births.
cannot_establish: incidence rates, risks, or causality since it does not include a denominator source for calculating rates.
